Subject: Recap: Discovery call — draft success criteria & next steps

Hi Elena / SkyBridge team,

Thanks again for the productive conversation this morning. Quick recap and proposed plan so we can align on who owns what for the 30-day POC: 

1) Primary evaluation goals (as I heard them):
   - Latency under 150ms 95th pct for 512-token requests
   - Cost per 1k requests under $0.60 (all-in)
   - Output quality: match baseline intent detection accuracy >= 92% on your eval set

2) Scope & assets we need from SkyBridge:
   - 1 representative prompt set (50–200 examples) + target labels
   - Sample traffic profile (concurrent users, avg seq len)
   - Contact for procurement (for test account provisioning)

3) Proposed kickoff & timeline:
   - Kickoff: Mon, Feb 22 — 30-day trial window Feb 22–Mar 23
   - Weekly sync: Fridays 10am PT (15m) — status + blockers

4) Ownership (proposed):
   - Redwood: infra & trial ops (rishi), test harness + monitoring (grace)
   - SkyBridge: eval set & procurement (Elena / procurement@skybridge.ai)

Attached: a lightweight ops checklist to accelerate setup.

Please confirm the success criteria above or reply with edits. If that looks good, I’ll send calendar invites and a short kickoff agenda.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 09:24:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Recap: Discovery call — draft success criteria & next steps

Thanks Rishi — this is helpful. A few clarifications from our side: 

- The 150ms 95th is ambitious but reasonable for our production profile; we might accept up to 200ms for some edge cases.
- For quality, can we define the exact metric? We run intent classification; we'd expect macro F1 >= 0.90.
- Procurement: looping in procurement@skybridge.ai for any legal/PO questions.

Action items for us:
- I’ll share a 100-example eval set by EOD Friday (Feb 13).
- I’ll confirm the traffic profile (avg seq len ~220 tokens, burst up to 40 concurrent).

Thanks — we’re excited to see the trial.

Best,
Elena
Director of Product, SkyBridge AI

Rishi / Lauren — attached is the MOP spreadsheet with the metrics we’ll use for acceptance. Key items: 

- Acceptance metrics: latency (95th), macro F1 on intent set, and monthly cost estimate at given concurrency.
- Data: the eval set will be redacted; we’ll provide labels and a small traffic sample.
- Security: we need assurance that logs and payloads are not stored beyond 30 days for this test.

Proposed acceptance thresholds (initial):
- Latency 95th <= 180ms
- Macro F1 >= 0.90
- Trial cost projection <= $0.70 / 1k requests

Attachment: skybridge-poc-mop.xlsx

Elena
